title: MiaomiaonV2 Battery Life
symptom: Since switching to Miaomiao V2, the sensor has another 4 days to run but the Miaomiao battery life is down to 15% and does not look like it will last the duration of the sensor.
fix: A user suggests buying a clip on mount that allows charging the unit, and another user found that applying only the double-sided sticker to the rectangular section of the Miaomiao 2 (not the round sticker) allows removing the transmitter without disturbing the sensor.
evidence_quote: I bought a clip on mount that works great with no adhesive, allows charging the unit.
